## Install

1. Install [a-Shell](https://apps.apple.com/app/a-shell/id1473805438) from the App Store and open it once.
2. On your iPhone or iPad, download **UMDL.shortcut** below and tap **Add Shortcut**. If an older UMDL is installed, choose **Replace**, or delete the old copy first.
3. Share a post or video to UMDL and tap **Quick setup**. Keep the shortcut named **UMDL**.

Full guide: [README](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL#readme). Every screen is described in [docs/BEHAVIOR.md](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL/blob/main/docs/BEHAVIOR.md). What changed: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

Something not working? [Open an issue](https://github.com/TheKfcBandit/UMDL/issues/new/choose).

Built and signed by this repository's CI. Signing uses the Shortcuty signing service; CI then reads the workflow back out of the signed file and publishes it only if it matches the build.
